inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes and look past the smoke and mirrors. The narrative that there is genuine division and disappointment between the United States and China over the Paris Agreement is nothing more than a carefully staged theatrical performance for the masses. When they feed the public stories about the US withdrawing from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration, it is merely a strategic maneuver to shift pieces on the board and advance the globalist agenda under a false flag of disagreement. The hidden elites are orchestrating these manufactured exits and supposed conflicts precisely to tighten their grip while concealing their real objectives away from public scrutiny.
